about.title: Social Media Komplett: the agency for local businesses
about.intro: Social Media Komplett is a social media agency based in Münster, serving businesses in Münster and across North Rhine-Westphalia (NRW). We create content, produce Reels and manage the channels of businesses that win customers over in person – in restaurants and cafés, salons, studios and local retail.
story: Many good businesses are barely visible online. Not because they have nothing to show, but because there is no time in day-to-day life: for ideas, for filming, for editing and for publishing regularly.

This is exactly where we come in. We come to your business, produce content that looks like your business, and then make sure it is published regularly and that questions from the community are answered.
Our aspiration is in our name: “komplett” – complete. You don’t just get individual posts, but a reliable process from planning through to reporting.

values.title: Honesty
values.text: We don’t promise follower numbers or revenue. We promise sound work, clear processes and open reporting.

values.title: Closeness
values.text: We get to know your business on site. That is the only way to create content that suits you.

values.title: Reliability
values.text: Agreed dates, fixed approvals, regular reports – you know what happens when.

values.title: Clarity
values.text: We explain what we do and why. Without technical terms nobody needs.

packages.explainerTitle: How much does social media management cost in Germany?
explainer: There is no one-size-fits-all answer, because the price depends on the scope. The most important factors are the number of channels managed, the volume of posts and Reels per month, the number of on-site shoots including travel, whether community management is included and how long the contract runs.

Monthly flat fees for ongoing management are common, as are project prices for individual services such as a shoot day or a strategy. When comparing quotes, pay attention to what exactly is included – in particular production, rounds of revisions, usage rights and reports.
We will give you our prices in a written quote after a short, free initial consultation.
packages.explainerLink: In-depth guide: how much does social media management cost?

faq.q: Why are there no prices here?
faq.a: Because the amount of work differs greatly from business to business. Instead of a price that doesn’t fit in the end, you receive a specific quote with a fixed monthly price after the initial consultation.
Yes. If your needs change, we adjust the scope at the next possible date. The details are in the quote.

faq.q: Are paid ads included in the package?
faq.a: No. The packages cover organic content and channel management. Paid ads can be booked as an add-on service; you pay the advertising budget directly to the platform.
No, and we advise caution with anyone who does. Reach and enquiries depend on many factors that nobody fully controls. We guarantee the agreed scope of services, sound work and honest reporting.

meta.title: FAQ: Questions and Answers on Social Media Management
meta.description: Answers to common questions: what is social media management, what does it cost, how does working together look, and will the agency come to my business?

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Here you will find short, honest answers to the questions businesses ask us most often. Is your question missing? Write to us.

items.a: Social media management covers all the recurring tasks around a business’s social media channels: planning topics, creating content, publishing posts, responding to comments and messages, and evaluating the results.

items.q: What does a social media agency do?
items.a: It takes on some or all of these tasks for a business. At Social Media Komplett this includes strategy, content creation, on-site Reels production, publishing, community management and reporting.

items.q: Is it worth outsourcing social media?
items.a: It is worth it if your business lacks the time or know-how for regular, well-made content. If you enjoy posting yourself, you can book individual building blocks such as a shoot or a strategy instead.

items.q: Which businesses do you work for?
items.a: Mainly local businesses: restaurants and cafés, hairdressing and beauty salons, gyms, retailers, trades and service providers.
In five steps: free initial consultation, strategy and content calendar, on-site content production, approval and publishing, regular reporting.

items.q: Do you come to my business to shoot?
items.a: Yes. Photos and videos are created right on your premises. We offer on-site shoots around Münster and in large parts of NRW, depending on the driving distance and individual arrangement.

items.q: How much time do I need to set aside myself?
items.a: Considerably less than before: time for the shoot dates, for approving the content and for short catch-ups. We take care of everything else.

items.q: Do I see posts before they go live?
items.a: Yes. You receive the content in advance for approval. Nothing is published without your consent.

items.q: Which languages do you work in?
items.a: We currently offer consultation and ongoing support in German. If you need content or conversations in another language, get in touch – we will tell you openly what is possible.

items.q: How much does social media management cost in Germany?
items.a: That depends on the scope: the number of channels, posts and Reels per month, on-site shoots, community management and the contract term. Monthly flat fees are common. You receive our prices as a written quote after a free initial consultation.
Term and notice period are set out transparently in the quote. Social media needs consistency over several months to have an effect – we take that into account in our recommendation.

items.q: Who owns the accounts and content?
items.a: The accounts always remain yours. The usage rights to the content created are set out in the quote.

items.q: How quickly will I see results?
items.a: A well-kept, consistent profile is visible quickly. Reach, community and enquiries usually develop over several months. A credible forecast in figures is not possible.

items.q: Do you guarantee more followers or revenue?
items.a: No. Nobody can credibly guarantee that. We guarantee the agreed scope of services and an honest evaluation of what has been achieved.
Using key figures that match your goal – such as reach, saved and shared posts, profile visits, link clicks and incoming enquiries. You receive a regular report on these.

items.q: Do you design menus as well?
items.a: Yes. We design new menus and rework existing ones – as a printed menu, PDF, QR code menu or takeaway flyer. Prices, allergens and all other details come from you and are approved by you.

items.q: What do you do for the Google Business Profile?
items.a: We review your profile, photograph your business, select images, edit them and upload the photos you have approved. On request, we maintain photos and details on a regular basis. The profile itself is a free Google product; what you pay for is our photography and maintenance work.

items.q: Do you need my Google password for this?
items.a: No. You add us as a manager in your profile and can remove the access again at any time. You remain the owner of the profile.

items.q: Can I book these services without a social media package?
items.a: Yes. Menu design and the photo refresh can be booked individually and combined with ongoing management – for example by using a shoot date for profile photos at the same time.
